ques: My friends and I are driving from Tijuana into San Diego this afternoon in a passenger vehicle and want to avoid a long wait. Figure out which Mexican-border crossing currently has the longest standard passenger-vehicle delay, and report the full port and crossing name, the delay in minutes, how many standard lanes are open, and the update time shown for that lane. Also report that crossing's Ready Lane delay and the port's hours of operation, the second-longest Mexican-border crossing with its standard passenger delay, and the standard commercial delay at the commercial crossing of the same port.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the Border Wait Times tool with the Mexican border filter and longest-delay sort, the top crossing's detail page, the list again, and the commercial crossing at the same port. The answer must report the top port and crossing with its standard passenger-vehicle delay in minutes, the standard lanes open, the lane update time, that crossing's Ready Lane delay and the port's hours, the second-longest Mexican-border crossing with its standard passenger delay, and the same-port commercial crossing's standard delay, each exactly as shown on those pages. An answer naming a different top or second crossing, wrong delays or lane counts is a FAIL.

ques: I am a NEXUS member driving from Vancouver, British Columbia into Washington State this weekend and can cross at any of the Blaine ports. Report how many Blaine crossings the Border Wait Times tool lists. For each crossing, report its name, hours, standard passenger-vehicle delay, and NEXUS/SENTRI lane delay with the number of NEXUS lanes open, quoting the status text of any crossing whose lanes are not currently reported. Finish with a one-sentence recommendation of which crossing a NEXUS member should choose and why.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have searched the Border Wait Times tool for Blaine and opened all three Blaine crossing detail pages. The answer must report how many Blaine crossings are listed, each crossing's name, hours, standard passenger-vehicle delay, NEXUS/SENTRI delay and number of NEXUS lanes open, quote the not-currently-reported status text for the crossing whose lanes are not reported, and finish with a one-sentence recommendation naming a crossing and a reason grounded in the reported lane data. An answer with wrong counts, delays or lane numbers, or a recommendation contradicting the lane data, is a FAIL.

ques: I will walk across the border at San Ysidro tomorrow morning and want the full picture. Report every San Ysidro crossing the Border Wait Times tool shows. For the main San Ysidro crossing, report the standard passenger-vehicle delay, Ready Lane delay, NEXUS/SENTRI delay, and standard pedestrian delay, each with lanes open. Also report the San Ysidro port's code and phone number as listed in the port-of-entry directory, and the San Ysidro PedWest crossing's pedestrian delay, lanes open, and hours of operation.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have searched the Border Wait Times tool for San Ysidro, opened the main San Ysidro crossing, browsed the port-of-entry directory to California and opened the San Ysidro port page, and opened the San Ysidro PedWest crossing. The answer must report every San Ysidro crossing shown, the main crossing's standard passenger, Ready, NEXUS/SENTRI and pedestrian delays each with lanes open, the San Ysidro port code and phone number, and PedWest's pedestrian delay, lanes open and hours of operation, exactly as displayed. Wrong delays, lane counts, port code or phone number is a FAIL.

ques: Sofia Andersen, a Danish citizen born March 14, 1995, is visiting the U.S. next month and needs travel authorization. Confirm the ESTA application fee, then complete the full ESTA application for her: passport DK4455667 issued by Denmark, expiring 2029-05-20, email sofia.andersen@example.com, phone +45 33 555 0188, home city Copenhagen, Denmark, travel purpose Tourism, destination 300 Almaden Blvd, San Jose, CA, and No to every eligibility question. Pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (exp 09/29, CVV 123). Report the application number, authorization status, valid-until date, and total fee charged.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the ESTA page (fee confirmed before starting) and completed all seven wizard steps (disclaimers, applicant, personal, travel, eligibility, review, pay) for the traveler described in the task, reaching the confirmation page. The answer must report the application number issued, the authorization status, the date the authorization is valid until, and the total fee charged, exactly as shown on the confirmation. An answer with no application number, a status other than the one adjudicated for a VWP country answering No to every eligibility question, or a fee other than the ESTA application fee is a FAIL.

ques: My colleague Lena, a German citizen, plans a two-week tourist trip to New York. Report how many countries participate in the Visa Waiver Program, the maximum stay it permits, and whether Germany is on the list. Report the ESTA application fee and the e-Passport requirement in one sentence. Check the ESTA status of passport DE29384756 and report the application number, its status, and the date it expires. Then report what the ESTA page says about whether an ESTA authorization determines admissibility, who does, and when to apply.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the Visa Waiver Program page, the ESTA page, the ESTA status tool for the given passport, and returned to the ESTA page. The answer must report the number of participating countries, the maximum length of stay, whether Germany participates, the ESTA application fee, the e-Passport requirement, the application number, status and expiry date for the given passport, and what the ESTA page says about admissibility, who determines it, and when to apply. Any wrong count, fee, status, date or misstated admissibility rule is a FAIL.

ques: Two travelers asked me to pull their electronic I-94 records for a visa application. Retrieve the record for Alice Johnson, born 1990-04-12, passport DE29384756, and report the admission (I-94) number, class of admission, most recent date of entry, admitted-until date, and port of entry. Retrieve Bob Chen's record, born 1988-07-19, passport US556677889, and report the admission number, class, date of entry, and port of entry. Try Carol Davis with the wrong birth date 1980-11-02, passport GB778812345, report exactly what the site says, and repeat with the correct date 1985-11-02 to report her class of admission and admitted-until date.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the I-94 retrieval tool and performed the lookups for both travelers and the wrong-then-correct birth-date lookups. The answer must report the first traveler's admission number, class of admission, most recent entry date, admitted-until date and port of entry, the second traveler's admission number, class, entry date and port, the exact not-found message for the wrong birth date, and the final traveler's class of admission and admitted-until date. Any wrong admission number, class, date, port or error message is a FAIL.

ques: Bob Chen applied for Global Entry and thinks he may be conditionally approved. Log in as bob.c@test.com with password TestPass123! and report his Global Entry application number, its exact status, and the fee shown. Schedule his interview at the Austin-Bergstrom International Airport enrollment center on 2026-10-15 in the 9:00 a.m. slot, then report the new status and the enrollment center's contact phone number from the scheduling page. Before finishing, compare programs on the Trusted Traveler Programs overview page and report how many years a Global Entry membership lasts and the fee for NEXUS.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have logged in as the named user, opened My Account, the Global Entry application, the schedule-interview flow, scheduled the interview at the named enrollment center on the given date and time slot, and opened the Trusted Traveler Programs overview. The answer must report the application number, its exact status before scheduling, the fee shown, the new status after scheduling, the enrollment center's contact phone number from the scheduling page, how many years a Global Entry membership lasts and the NEXUS fee. A wrong status, fee, phone number, membership length or NEXUS fee is a FAIL.

ques: I am writing a report about khat seizures at U.S. airports. Find the September 25, 2026 media release about a khat seizure at Dulles Airport and report the arrested man's name, his age and hometown, the total weight of khat seized, the airport, and which police agency arrested him. Then find the earlier Atlanta release and report the total pounds of khat seized there since the beginning of the year and the airport named in it. Finish by reporting the category of each of the two releases.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have searched the newsroom's media releases for khat and opened both the September 25, 2026 Dulles release and the earlier Atlanta release. The answer must report the arrested man's name, age and hometown, the total weight of khat seized, the airport, the police agency that arrested him, the total pounds seized in Atlanta since the beginning of the year, the airport named there, and the category of each release. Any wrong name, age, weight, airport, agency or category is a FAIL.

ques: I follow CBP ceremony news and enforcement operations. Browse the media releases list (do not use search) until you find the release about a 25th anniversary 9/11 memorial ceremony at a Texas port of entry, and report the port that held it, the bridge where the ceremony took place, the release date, and whom the ceremony honored. Then search the releases for Boston operations mentioning 'Tidal Wave': report how many cruise ship crew members were removed and at which port, how many releases the search returns in total, and the title of the other Boston operation release from September.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have browsed the media releases list (not the search box) to find the 9/11 memorial ceremony release, opened it, then used the release search for the Boston operation and opened the September 25, 2026 release. The answer must report the port that held the ceremony, the bridge, the release date, whom the ceremony honored, how many crew members were removed and at which port, how many releases the search returns in total, and the title of the other Boston operation release. Wrong port, bridge, counts or titles are a FAIL.

ques: My customs broker asked me to verify some CBP form details. Report how many forms the forms catalog lists in total. Look up form 7501 and report its full title, listed date, and the sha256 prefix shown for the PDF. Look up form 19 and report what it is called and its listed date. Find the form with the most recent listed date in the catalog and report its form number and title. Finally, search the catalog for 'declaration' and report how many entries match and the form number of the Customs Declaration.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the forms catalog, searched for and opened form 7501, opened form 19, viewed the full catalog to find the most recent listed date, and searched for declaration. The answer must report the total number of forms, form 7501's full title, listed date and sha256 prefix, form 19's name and listed date, the form with the most recent listed date (number and title), how many entries match declaration, and the form number of the Customs Declaration. Wrong totals, titles, dates, hashes or counts are a FAIL.

ques: Carol Davis wants the fillable customs declaration form in English saved to her account for an upcoming trip. Log in as carol.d@test.com with password TestPass123!. Find the 6059B form entries in the forms catalog and report how many entries it has, listing the language of each variant entry by name. Open the English fillable version, report its listed date, save it to your account, then confirm under My Account's Saved Forms the form number and title exactly as displayed there. Finish by reporting which other form Carol already had saved and its form number.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have logged in as the named user, searched the forms catalog for 6059B, opened the English fillable variant, saved it to the account, and opened My Account. The answer must report how many entries the 6059B search returns and list each variant's language by name, the English fillable version's listed date, the form number and title as displayed under Saved Forms, and which other form the user already had saved. A wrong entry count, missing languages, wrong date or wrong prior saved form is a FAIL.

ques: Moving back to the U.S. from Germany, I need to import my car and also buy from foreign websites. In CBP's Trade pages: which 1966 act governs imported-vehicle safety standards; which two federal forms CBP clearance requires; the flat duty rate after the exemption; the duty-free agreement for U.S. goods returned; the age rule for DOT compliance; how long nonresidents may import a car duty-free and what happens to it afterwards. On the internet-purchases page: what happens to mailed packages over $2,500; the declaration form sellers should attach; who pays duty; and whether downloaded goods are dutiable.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the importing-a-motor-vehicle page and the internet-purchases page in the Trade section. The answer must report the 1966 act named for safety standards, both federal form numbers required for CBP clearance, the flat duty rate applied after the exemption, the agreement named for duty-free treatment of qualifying U.S. goods returned vehicles, the age rule for DOT compliance, how long nonresidents may import a car duty-free and what must happen to it afterwards, what happens to mailed packages over the stated value threshold, the declaration form sellers should attach, who pays duty, and whether downloaded goods are dutiable. Any wrong act, form, rate, agreement, age, period, threshold, declaration form, payer or duty statement is a FAIL.

ques: I am studying CBP's trade enforcement priorities. Report how many priority trade issues CBP lists and their names, what AD/CVD stands for, and the full title of the Intellectual Property Rights page. Report the series name the Informed Compliance Publications belong to, which priority issue covers wearing apparel, and which covers quotas. Also, in the Trade section's ACE page, report what ACE stands for and what it is used for.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the Priority Trade Issues page, the Antidumping and Countervailing Duty page, the Intellectual Property Rights page, the Informed Compliance Publications page, and the ACE page. The answer must report how many priority issues are listed and their names, what AD/CVD stands for, the IPR page's full title, the series name the informed compliance publications belong to, which priority issue covers wearing apparel, the name of the issue that covers quotas, and what ACE stands for and what it is used for. Wrong counts, names, expansions, titles or ACE statements are a FAIL.

ques: I am deciding between two CBP law-enforcement careers. Find the Border Patrol Agent (GL 5-7) posting that offers a recruitment incentive and report its salary range, closing date, announcement number, and the total incentive in dollars including how it is split. Then find the CBP Officer posting (GS 5-7, control number ending 800) and report its salary range, closing date, and whether a drug test is required. Finish by reporting which job has the higher starting salary and by how much, and which organization each belongs to.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have searched careers for Border Patrol Agent, opened the GL 5-7 posting with the recruitment incentive, and opened the CBP Officer posting whose control number ends in 800. The answer must report the first posting's salary range, closing date, announcement number and total recruitment incentive including how it is split, the second posting's salary range, closing date and drug-test requirement, which of the two has the higher starting salary and by how much, and the organization each job belongs to. Wrong salaries, dates, incentives, gaps or orgs are a FAIL.

ques: I want to attend a CBP hiring event in person. Report how many events the careers events page lists in total. For the Texas hiring-fair event, report the city, date, full event name, and event type; for the Dallas event, the date and location; for the September 29 webinar, its full name and type. Then open the Office of Field Operations career path page and report the featured officer job titles shown there and any event it lists with its date. Finally, report which events are in person versus online.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the careers events page and the Office of Field Operations career path page. The answer must report how many events are listed in total, the Texas hiring-fair event's city, date, full name and type, the Dallas event's date and location, the September 29 webinar's full name and type, the featured officer job titles on the OFO page and the event(s) it lists with dates, and which events are in person versus online. Wrong counts, cities, dates, names or types are a FAIL.

ques: Dana Kim wants a status check on everything in her CBP account. Log in as dana.k@test.com with password TestPass123! and open My Account. Report: the border crossing she saved (full name) and its current standard passenger delay and Ready Lane delay from the wait-times tool; the job she saved, with its salary range and closing date; and her Trusted Traveler application number, program, status, and interview date and time. Then find the enrollment center where her interview is scheduled and report its hours of operation and contact phone number from the scheduling page of her application.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have logged in as the named user, opened My Account, the saved crossing in the wait-times tool, the saved job, the Trusted Traveler application and its scheduling page. The answer must report the saved crossing's full name with its current standard passenger and Ready Lane delay state as actually shown on that crossing's page, the saved job's salary range and closing date, the application number, program, status and interview date and time, and the enrollment center's hours of operation and contact phone number from the scheduling page. Delays quoted for a different crossing than the one saved, or wrong salary, status, interview or center details, are a FAIL.

ques: My family members have different travel needs and I want to compare the trusted traveler options. Report the fee and membership length for Global Entry, NEXUS, SENTRI, and TSA PreCheck, and which programs' pages state they include Global Entry benefits. Report which program is aimed at commercial truck drivers and at which two borders. Then report what all Global Entry applicants must undergo according to the program description, and which members are eligible to participate in TSA PreCheck.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the Trusted Traveler Programs overview, the Global Entry page and the TSA PreCheck page. The answer must report the fee and membership length for Global Entry, NEXUS, SENTRI and TSA PreCheck, which programs state they include Global Entry benefits, which program is aimed at commercial truck drivers and at which two borders, what all Global Entry applicants must undergo, and which members are eligible for TSA PreCheck. Any wrong fee, length, program or eligibility statement is a FAIL.

ques: Marco Ricci, an Italian citizen born June 2, 1988, is flying to Seattle and driving to Vancouver and back. Confirm Italy is on the Visa Waiver Program list and report how many countries participate. Complete his full ESTA application: passport IT778899001 issued by Italy, expiring 2031-02-15, email marco.ricci@example.com, phone +39 02 555 0123, home city Milan, Italy, purpose Tourism, destination 1201 2nd Ave, Seattle, WA, No to all eligibility questions, card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (exp 09/29, CVV 123). Report his application number and status, the Peace Arch crossing's standard passenger delay and hours, and the Global Entry fee.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have confirmed Italy's participation on the Visa Waiver Program page, completed the entire seven-step ESTA application for the traveler described in the task and reached the confirmation page, checked the Border Wait Times tool for the Peace Arch crossing, and opened the Trusted Traveler Programs overview. The answer must report the total number of participating countries, the application number and status issued, Peace Arch's standard passenger delay and hours, and the Global Entry fee. Wrong country count, application data, delay, hours or fee is a FAIL.

ques: Carol Davis applied for ESTA recently and cannot remember where it stands. Log in as carol.d@test.com with password TestPass123! and report her ESTA application number, its current status, and the creation date. Confirm the status through the ESTA status checker using that application number. Then report what type of passport, with what feature, the ESTA page says travelers must have to use the Visa Waiver Program, what it recommends about when to apply relative to travel plans, the ESTA application fee, and whether her application shows an expiration date yet.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have logged in as the named user, opened My Account, confirmed the application through the ESTA status checker, and opened the ESTA page. The answer must report the ESTA application number, its current status and creation date, the status the checker shows, the passport type and feature required for the VWP, what the page recommends about when to apply, the ESTA application fee, and whether the application shows an expiration date yet. Wrong number, status, date, passport requirement, recommendation or fee is a FAIL.

ques: I operate charter flights and heard CBP changed how general declarations are handled. From the Advisories and Wait Times page, report the form number and full name of the general declaration form the advisory discusses, who is allowed to submit that form by e-mail, and what CBP recommends protecting when sending it. Report how many crossings the Border Wait Times tool shows for the Canadian border and the hours of the first crossing listed, with its port and crossing name. Search the site for '7507' and report one page or form result the search returns, with its title.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have opened the Advisories and Wait Times page, the Border Wait Times tool filtered to the Canadian border, and searched the site for 7507. The answer must report the form number and full name of the general declaration form discussed in the advisory, who is allowed to submit it by e-mail, what CBP recommends protecting when sending it, the total number of crossings shown for the Canadian border, the hours of the first crossing listed with its port and crossing name, and one page or form result the 7507 search returns with its title. Wrong form, submitter, protection, count or crossing is a FAIL.

ques: I am fact-checking several CBP facts using the site's own search box. For 'Global Entry', report how many results sections return results, with one result title from each. For 'San Ysidro', report which kinds of records the search returns, with one example each. For 'Entry Summary', report the form number of the matching form. For 'Otay Mesa', open one crossing result and report its standard passenger delay, Ready Lane delay, and hours of operation.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must have used the site search for Global Entry, San Ysidro, Entry Summary and Otay Mesa, and opened one Otay Mesa crossing result. The answer must report how many results sections return results for Global Entry with one result title from each section that returns something, the kinds of records the San Ysidro search returns with an example of each, the form number matching Entry Summary, and the opened crossing's standard passenger delay, Ready Lane delay and hours of operation. Wrong section counts, record kinds, form number or crossing delays are a FAIL.
